Q: Alternative for the = sign A:

Oneliner, inspired by Michael Burr: x += (y-x);. Works for all numeric types, O(1), even std::complex, as well as random iterators (including pointers).

Q: Why is my Next.js app slow on first load and how can I improve initial load performance? A:

Have you tried to reproduce the situation on localhost? Also be aware that DOM isn’t rendering until the fetch, you could consider separating the rendering of the structure from the fetchings.

Q: Built a Privacy Policy Analyzer with LLMs, but it's slow A:

Do some profiling. At the minimum you can add print statements when each block starts so you will have an exact time of how long each part takes and then you can make a decision based on what you've learned.

Q: how to use requests and selenium at the same time and handle cookies with them? A:

This isn't an advice question, it's a coding question. You need to move it to the proper question type and add the code that you've tried, post the full error message, and explain in what way it's not working.

Q: Can't get personal access tokens to work with github for own repo A:

First, make sure your token has at least the repo scope.

Second, the GitHub official documentation confirms:

$ git clone https://github.com/username/repo.git
Username: your_username
Password: your_token

Double-check the output of git config --global credential.helper to make sure nothing was cached. The only one I use on CentOS7 is git config --global credential.helper 'cache --timeout 3600'.

Check also your version of Git (I know on my CentOS7 server, it can be... quite old: 1.8.x! And yes, no SSH egress would ever be allowed)

Finally, from this thread, try and make sure you have 2FA activated for your GitHub account.

Q: Pip doesn't require root user to install but requires root user to upgrade A:

The command to install pip as root is

sudo apt-get install pip

It should then prompt you for your password. I recommend using sudo whenever you install something.
